svg.title: Tangentially elliptic scalar collar tests
svg.desc: One normalized circle covector fiber with allowed cone abs kappa less than three abs eta and target region abs kappa at most abs eta. Normal directions are omitted, tangential directions retained. The exact Gaussian kernel factor and proof maps describe one scalar collar test with the original Banach remainder.
svg.text: κ² + η² = 1; every boundary base point
s⁰(h) = g(h) Σ cₙ exp(inh) J*PₙJ
All derivatives have every exponential tail.
β = 1 below 3a; input χ supported below 2a; omitted output has h ≥ log(3/2).
Proof locators: Q0–Q1, F0, G0–G2, E0–E1, A0–A1, T0. Global interior gluing remains open.
